NTEE classification rendered as text

Source: R/text.R
pf_ntee_text.Rd

A lookup from NTEE code to a bag of words describing that code: the level 3-5 labels, the category name and description, and the keyword list. Keyed twice — by the NTEEv2 three-part code (ART-A00-AA) and by the legacy three-character code (A23) — because the BMF populates the two unevenly. On the audit sample the NTEEv2 key resolves 38% of candidates and the legacy key a further 51%, for 89% combined.

Usage

pf_ntee_text(x = NULL)

Arguments

x

Optional replacement lookup, in the shape of nteev2 — a list with by_v2 and by_legacy, each a table of key and ref.

Value

A list with by_v2 and by_legacy lookup tables.

Details

The table ships with the package as nteev2 (1,082 codes, 84 KB); this accessor exists so a caller can substitute a newer vintage without editing code. Rebuild the bundled copy with data-raw/make-nteev2.R.

See also

nteev2 for the bundled data.
